info.title: Sewak Cloudflare API
info.description: D1-backed opaque sessions and role authorization. No Firebase runtime dependency. /auth endpoints also have /api/auth aliases. Cookie unsafe requests require same-origin Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Application writes are rejected while health.writesEnabled=false. Resource fields and workflow validation are documented in MOBILE_API.md and D1_SCHEMA.md.
